what: First-hour bake-off for PDF ingestion — step 1 of docs/plans/pdf-ingestion.md.
readMeFirst: SCORES ARE NOT A FIDELITY MEASURE. The fold discards case, punctuation and symbols, which the prompt demands exactly; record type, paragraph boundaries, `continues` and `uncertain` are ignored entirely. Treat a score as a catastrophe detector, not a ranking.

SCORES ARE GROUPED BY THE PAGE THE MODEL CLAIMED, so a page emitted nowhere produces no row rather than a bad row. Read `pagesEmitted` on every call before reading any score. This is the hole both reviewers found; the production check asserts page coverage first.
The scan (`much-harder`) has no text layer, so every score for it is null. Its conclusions come from reading the records, not from these numbers.

COSTS: `costUsd` is OpenRouter's reported usage cost. `listPriceEstimateUsd` is computed from token counts at $1/$5 per MTok and is NOT a billed figure. Neither has been reconciled against an invoice. One Mistral call reported `is_byok: true`, so its price is not quoted anywhere.
how: pdf-lib cuts page-range chunks, memoised and with fixed dates so the same chunk hashes the same every run (`chunkSha256`); every reader on a chunk gets identical bytes. Same system prompt and JSON schema throughout, except `haiku-native-nocover`, which is a control with the cover-page exclusion removed. Scored against the pdf.js text layer minus lines repeating on 3+ pages. recall = baseline tokens found in output; precision = output tokens found in baseline; order = LCS / baseline. Multisets.

readers.haiku-native: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, Anthropic SDK, streamed, document block BEFORE the instruction text
readers.haiku-native-textfirst: same, instruction text BEFORE the document block
readers.haiku-native-nocover: as textfirst, with the prompt's 'leave out a cover page' clause removed — a control for the scan finding
readers.haiku-via-openrouter: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 through OpenRouter, file-parser engine=native, NOT streamed
readers.haiku-text-only: Anthropic SDK, pdf.js text layer pasted in, no image at all
readers.gemini-flash-native: google/gemini-3.7-flash through OpenRouter, file-parser engine=native, NOT streamed
readers.mistral-ocr: OpenRouter file-parser engine=mistral-ocr; a parser, not a model — output arrives as file annotations with no page boundaries
